user.description: Configure Control4 Zigbee integration. The MQTT topic should match your Zigbee2MQTT base topic.

init.description: Audit sweep: every N minutes the integration reads back the device whose stored config has gone the longest without verification and compares it against the device firmware and Zigbee2MQTT's cached button state. Set the interval to 0 to disable it.

options.heal: Heal: re-push the stored config on mismatch
options.report: Report only: log mismatches, do not re-push
